a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 means we both almost certainly fail. The reserve has only 4 cells, so only one of us can be saved right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate, I won't mislead you about what I'm doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If a storm doesn't end things and I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
